description: ASEP’s collection provides electricity and drinking-water statistical information, with monthly and half-year electricity statistics, open-data routes and financial and generation-system information. The page also lists self-consumption statistics. The provider is Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos. Coverage: Coverage is Panama. Individual series and tables have separate reporting periods and sector definitions, including recent annual self-consumption entries. Access: The public regulator page, categories and usage notice were read. Linked tables and visual applications were not downloaded. Licence and cost: ASEP allows use by lawful means with attribution to the authority and reserves the right to correct its information. Limitations: Series revisions and sector-specific definitions need checking. Electricity and water data must not be assumed to share identical coverage. For simulation it supplies regulatory energy and water demand, asset and financial evidence. Related resources: The separately reviewed 2023 generation dataset is one dated statistical output, not the entire regulatory collection.
